info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete P2m By Refund Id-spec
info.description: The P2M Refund Management API facilitates the removal of payment transactions associated with specific refund requests. This endpoint allows businesses to efficiently manage their payment processing by deleting transactions linked to a given refund ID. Typical consumers include payment processing teams and financial reconciliation systems, enabling them to ensure accurate records. By utilizing this operation, users can maintain compliance and streamline their financial operations.

delete.summary: Delete a refund by its unique identifier.
delete.description: This operation allows you to permanently remove a refund record identified by its unique identifier. Use this carefully, as it cannot be undone.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details required for processing the refund operation identified by RES-100045. Ensure to follow the schema provided to submit the correct information.

204.description: The refund was successfully deleted with no content returned.
